findings.evidence: Rule check: "4 channel(s) not assigned to a sample: TMT132C, TMT133N, TMT133C, TMT134N." The description says: "Four channels are unused." The SDRF lists 12 samples, TMT126 to TMT132N.
findings.explanation: The 12 samples use 12 of the 16 TMTpro channels. The four unused channels (TMT132C, TMT133N, TMT133C, TMT134N) match the description, so this is the expected result of running 12 samples on a 16-plex kit. The empty channels only matter if they were not truly empty, because signal in them would be contamination or isotope spillover. They have no effect on the antibody-by-treatment comparison.
findings.suggested_fix: No change is needed. Optionally, note in the SDRF or the data submission that these four channels were intentionally left empty.

summary: The SDRF agrees with the description on organism, cell line, disease, treatments, antibodies, trypsin, TMTpro and the 12 samples. The only item is the expected warning that four TMTpro 16-plex channels are unused, which the description already states.
